title: Living Together Replaced Marriage At Both Ends Of Adulthood
hook: Young adults live with partners more than spouses—and older adults are joining.
closing: Living together now spans adulthood, not merely the years before marriage.
question: Would you live together before marriage?

segments.say: Among young adults, 9 percent live with an unmarried partner. That now exceeds living with a spouse.
Spousal living fell to 40 percent among adults aged twenty-five to thirty-four. Marriage lost its former dominance in early adulthood.
Cohabiting adults aged fifty-plus reached 4.2 million. Living together now stretches well beyond the young.
